keyVerseDR: "For whosoever shall give you to drink a cup of water in my name... he shall not lose his reward." (Mk 9:40 DR)

level1.title: A Cup of Water
level1.story: John said, "Someone not with us was casting out demons in Your name." Jesus said, "Whoever is not against us is for us." Even giving a cup of water in His name counts!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What small gift did Jesus talk about?
What kind thing can you do?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me do small good things. Amen.

activity.title: Little kindnesses
activity.intro: Small acts of love count! Do one at home.
items: Tidy the home crucifix or Mary statue
Bring someone a cup of water

level2.title: Whoever Is Not Against Us
level2.story: John said, "Master, we saw one casting out devils in Thy name, and we forbade him." Jesus said, "Do not forbid him. For he that is not against you, is for you." He said that whoever gives you a cup of water in His name shall not lose his reward. Jesus warned against leading little ones into sin. He said it is better to give up anything that causes us to sin than to lose heaven.
level2.keyLine: Whosoever shall give you to drink a cup of water in my name, shall not lose his reward.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why does Jesus take sin so seriously?
How can you help others do good?
actions: Avoid what leads me to sin
level2.prayer: Jesus, help me be a good example. Amen.

activity.title: God's gifts, my thanks
activity.intro: Weigh it up: God's gifts on one side, my thanks on the other.
